about_blocks.text: Hidden Secret Recovery: Private Residential Addiction Treatment in Nauwigewauk, New Brunswick
about_blocks.html: Hidden Secret Recovery: Private Residential Addiction Treatment in Nauwigewauk, New Brunswick

about_blocks.text: Hidden Secret Recovery is a small private addiction treatment centre on Darlings Island in Nauwigewauk, a few minutes from Hampton in Kings County. It runs a live-in program for adults working on alcohol or drug use, and it takes no more than eight people at a time. The program is housed in a restored private home on a gated property, so residents eat at a real dining table and sleep in ordinary bedrooms.
about_blocks.html: Hidden Secret Recovery is a small private addiction treatment centre on Darlings Island in Nauwigewauk, a few minutes from Hampton in Kings County. It runs a live-in program for adults working on alcohol or drug use, and it takes no more than eight people at a time. The program is housed in a restored private home on a gated property, so residents eat at a real dining table and sleep in ordinary bedrooms.

about_blocks.text: The standard stay is 30 days, and the centre adjusts the length to the person. Days follow a set routine of one-to-one counselling, group sessions, shared meals, wellness activities and some free time. The centre tests for drugs and alcohol throughout the stay, and it builds 12 step work and peer support into the program. Staff are on site around the clock.

about_blocks.text: The clinical side includes a Registered Nurse, a Licensed Practical Nurse and Licensed Addiction Counsellors, along with social work graduates and a CanAm-certified interventionist. The centre also says it is an approved provider with the New Brunswick Department of Social Development. Many of the residential workers are in recovery themselves and say so on the centre's team page.

about_blocks.text: Not everyone needs to live in. Hidden Secret Recovery also offers outpatient counselling, delivered as one-to-one virtual sessions with flexible scheduling, and a support program for parents, partners and other family members. Anyone who finishes the live-in program or outpatient services can join a year of aftercare with group sessions and regular check-ins.

about_blocks.text: This is a private, fee-based centre and New Brunswick Medicare does not cover it. The 30-day residential program costs $11,500, and financing is available through MediCard. The centre issues receipts for some benefit plans, including Telus Health and Medavie Blue Cross, and works with referral pathways such as WorkSafeNB and NIHB for eligible clients. Families, doctors, social workers, employers and EAP providers can all make a referral.

about_blocks.text: Adam Beman founded the centre with his parents, Mike and Lisa Beman, after the family went through addiction together. Adam is in recovery himself and leads the program as director. Saint John is about half an hour away, and Moncton and Fredericton are each roughly an hour and a half by car.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Hidden Secret Recovery

faqs.question: How much does Hidden Secret Recovery cost?

answer_blocks.text: The standard 30-day residential program costs $11,500, as published on the centre's website. Financing through MediCard is available, with an example rate of about $214 a month over 72 months. Payment is private, so call the centre to go over your options.
answer_blocks.html: The standard 30-day residential program costs $11,500, as published on the centre's website. Financing through MediCard is available, with an example rate of about $214 a month over 72 months. Payment is private, so call the centre to go over your options.

faqs.question: Is Hidden Secret Recovery covered by Medicare or insurance?

answer_blocks.text: No, it is a private centre and New Brunswick Medicare does not cover the program. The centre provides receipts for eligible services to plans such as Telus Health and Medavie Blue Cross, and some employer benefit plans and EAP programs may cover part of the cost. WorkSafeNB, NIHB and Social Development NB referrals are accepted in eligible or approved cases.

faqs.question: How long is the residential program?

answer_blocks.text: The live-in program typically lasts 30 days. The centre says it adjusts the length to each person's needs. A year of aftercare follows the residential stay.

faqs.question: Does Hidden Secret Recovery offer detox?

answer_blocks.text: The centre's website does not list a medical detox service, and its recovery.com profile lists detox as not offered. If you are still drinking or using heavily, ask the admissions team on the first call how withdrawal should be handled before you arrive.

faqs.question: Who works at Hidden Secret Recovery?

answer_blocks.text: The team includes a Registered Nurse, a Practical Nurse, a Licensed Addiction Counsellor, social work graduates and a CanAm-certified interventionist. Staff are on site 24 hours a day. Many of the residential workers have their own lived experience of addiction and recovery.

answer_blocks.text: The centre takes a maximum of eight residents. It is a restored private home on a gated property on Darlings Island, with shared bedrooms, a shared kitchen and a dining room. A detached building holds a games room, a movie theatre and a gym.

faqs.question: Where is Hidden Secret Recovery and how do I get there?

answer_blocks.text: The centre is at 277 Darlings Island Road in Nauwigewauk, New Brunswick, near Hampton in Kings County. Saint John is about 30 minutes away by car, Sussex about 40 minutes, and Moncton and Fredericton each about an hour and a half. Call before you travel so the team can plan your arrival.
